purpose: Restore the real PLATFORM_OWNER access path for issue #4414 by requesting one ordinary password-reset email for the sole active owner/reviewer after production proves password-ready but MFA-not-enrolled. This is a recovery request only; it does not set a password, MFA secret, role, membership, tenant or business identity.
requiredInvariants: Only the repository owner or the trusted ChatGPT connector acting for the repository owner may trigger the production command.
The immutable reviewed reset source script is copied to RUNNER_TEMP and must retain its exact reviewed blob before the bounded readiness substitution.

The readiness exception permits password_ready_count to be either 0 or 1 only; active owner, usable reviewer, assignment, active identity and verified membership must each equal 1; MFA-enrolled and login-ready must each equal 0.
No reviewer email, reset token, password, TOTP secret, backup code, SMTP credential, SSH key, database URL or decrypted auth-mail payload may be published.
The only production mutation is one normal POST to /api/auth/forgot-password and its ordinary durable password-reset challenge/outbox effects.
No direct password write, direct MFA write, role mutation, tenant mutation, business membership impersonation, auth/RBAC weakening or customer-data read is allowed.
API, Web and auth-mail worker must each have OCI revision exactly equal to the command-time current main SHA. Any runtime drift fails closed before the reset request.
The owner-access recovery wrapper must not patch or weaken the reviewed source script revision-parity guards.
acceptance: PR changes only this scope manifest and the owner-only recovery workflow.
Contract validates exact source blob, exact readiness-patch cardinality, unchanged exact-main revision guards and owner/connector provenance.
Before the production reset command, exact current main must be released to REG.RU with API, Web and auth-mail worker all on that same SHA.
Production request returns HTTP 202 and durable PASSWORD_RESET outbox reaches SENT.
A fresh one-time reset email reaches the connected owner mailbox without exposing its token in GitHub evidence.
After the human sets a password, the normal login flow requires TOTP enrollment before /platform-v7/staff owner access.
